English: This chapter discusses the current state of healthcare, challenges and potential local and cross-national solutions related to multiple morbidity in low and middle income countries and vulnerable populations in high income countries, based on interdisciplinary research of provider workload in South Africa and the Caribbean.
Luganda: Essuula eno ennyonnyola embeera y’ebyobulamu eriwo kaakano, okusoomooza okwekuusa ku mbeera y’okubeera n’endwadde ennyingi n’amagezi  ag’omunda mu ggwanga ssaako amagezi bbunamawanga ag’okukuvvuunuka mu mawanga agakyakula n’abantu abali mu bwetaavu mu mawanga agaakula edda, okusinziira ku kunoonyereza ku mirimu gy’omujjanjabi mu ggwanga lya South Africa n’erya Caribbean.
Yoruba: Orí yìí jíròrò nípa ipò tí ètò ìlera wà lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, àwọn ìṣòro tó ń kọjú rẹ̀ àti àwọn ọ̀nà àbáyọ tí ó jẹ́ mọ́ oníruurú ìbújáde àrùn ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ọrọ̀ aje wọn burú jáì àti àwọn tí ọrọ̀ ajé wọn gbé pẹ́lí díẹ̀ àti ìdá àwọn tí wọn wà nínú ewu ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ọrọ̀ ajẹ́ wọ́n ti dára púpọ̀, èyí tí ó dá lórí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ajẹmọ onírúurú iṣẹ́ nípa bí iṣẹ́ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera ṣe pọ̀ tọ́ ní South Africa àti Caribbean.
Zulu: Lesi sahluko sidingida isimo samanje sokunakekelwa kwempilo, izinselele kanye nezixazululo ezingaba khona zendawo nezamazwe ngamazwe ezihlobene nokugula okuningi emazweni anemali engenayo ephansi naphakathi kanye nabantu abasengozini emazweni anemali engenayo ephezulu, ngokusekelwe ocwaningweni lwezinhlaka ezahlukene lomthwalo womsebenzi wabahlinzeki eNingizimu Afrika naseCaribbean.
Hausa: Wannan babi ya tattauna halin da ake ciki na kiwon lafiya a halin yanzu, ƙalubaloli da mafita mai yiwuwa ta gida da ta ƙasa da take da alaƙa da rashin lafiya masu yawa a cikin ƙasashe masu ƙanana da matsakaita n kuɗin shiga da kuma yawan jama’a masu rauni a cikin manyan ƙasashe masu samun kuɗin shiga, bisa ga bincike dabam-dabam na ayyukan samar da nauyin aiki a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Caribbean.
Northern Sotho: Kgaolo ye e ahlaahla seemo sa bjale sa tlhokomelo ya maphelo, ditlhohlo le ditharollo tše di kgonagalago tša bosetšhaba tša ka nageng le tša ka dinageng tše dingwe tšeo di amanago le malwetši a mantši ka dinageng tša letseno la fase le tša letseno la magareng le ditšhabeng tšeo di lego kotsing ka dinageng tša letseno la godimo, go lebeletšwe dinyakišišo tša makala a mantši ka ga bontši bja mošomo wa moabi ka Afrika Borwa le ka Caribbean.
Amharic: ይህ ምእራፍ በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በካሪቢያን አካባቢ በአገልግሎት አቅራቢዎች የስራ ጫና ላይ የተመሰረተ ሁለንተናዊ ምርምር ላይ በመመርኮዝ፣ ዝቅተኛ እና መካከለኛ ገቢ ባላቸው ሀገራት እና ከፍተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው ሀገራት ውስጥ ካሉ በርካታ የበሽታዎች ህመማዊ ተጓዳኝነት ጋር በተያያዙ የጤና አጠባበቅ ሁኔታዎች ፣ ተግዳሮቶች እና እምቅ አካባቢያዊ እና አገራዊ መፍትሄዎችን ያብራራል።

English: With a high chronic and noncommunicable disease (NCD) and HIV burden in both settings, it is not uncommon to find patients having this double burden of disease.
Luganda: Ng’ebitundu byombi birina obuzibu obw’amaanyi obw’endwadde ey’olukonziba (NCD) ne HIV, kya bulijjo okusanga abalwadde abalina ekizibu ky’endwadde zino ez’emirundi ebiri.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àìsàn tí ó burú jáì àti àìsàn tí kìí ràn mọ́ ni (NCD) bẹ́ẹ̀ni HIV wọ́pọ̀ ní orílẹ̀ èdè méjèèjì, kò ṣe aláìwọ́pọ̀ láti rí àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní aìsàn onígbáméjì yìí.
Zulu: Ngesifo esingelapheki esiphezulu nesingatheleleki (NCD) kanye nomthwalo we-HIV kuzo zombili izimo, akuvamile ukuthola iziguli zinalo mthwalo ophindwe kabili wezifo.
Hausa: Tare da yawan cuta mai tsanani da cuta mara yaɗuwa (NCD) da nauyin HIV a cikin wuraren biyu, ba sabon abu ba ne a sami marasa lafiya da auke da wannan nauyin nau’o’i biyu na cuta.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge go na le malwetši a mantši a go se fole le a go se fetelwe (NCD) le morwalo wa HIV ka maemong a ka bobedi, ga se selo seo se sego sa tlwaelega go hwetša balwetši ba na le malwetši a ka bobedi ao a nago le morwalo.
Amharic: ከፍተኛ ሥር የሰደደ እና ተላላፊ ያልሆኑ በሽታዎች (ኤንሲዲ) እና የኤችአይቪ ጫና በሁለቱም ቦታዎች፣ ይህን ድርብ የበሽታ ሸክም ያለባቸው ታካሚዎችን ማግኘት የተለመደ ነገር አይደለም።

English: Additionally, patient resiliency is exacerbated by the multiplication of both demands made by the interactions from treatment modalities and multiple service providers.
Luganda: Okwongereza ku ekyo, okuguma kw’abalwadde kusajjulwa okuzaalukana kw’ebyetaago byombi ebiva mu nkolagana eziva mu nzijanjaba ey’enjawulo n’abajjanjabi ab’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Ní àfikún, bí ara àwọn alaísàn ṣe le è tètè yá dá lórí irúfẹ́ ipa tí àkópọ̀ àrùn yìí ni láti ara àkànpọ̀ ipa  ìtọ́jú àìsàn méjèèjì àti oníruurú àwọn olùṣètọ́jú.
Zulu: Ukwengeza, ukuqina kwesiguli kubhebhezelwa ukuphindaphindeka kwakho kokubili okufunwa ukusebenzelana okuvela ezindleleni zokwelashwa kanye nabahlinzeki besevisi abaningi.
Hausa: Bugu da ƙari, ƙarfin juriya na majiyyaci yana ƙaruwa ta hanyar ninka buƙatun biyu da aka yi ta hanyar hulɗar daga hanyoyin jiyya da masu ba da ayyuka da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Godimo ga fao, kgotlelelo ya balwetši e mpefatšwa ke go ata ga bobedi ga dinyakego tšeo di dirwago ke dikamano go tšwa go mahu ao a bago gona le ge go abja kalafo le ke baabi ba ditirelo ba bantši.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም፣ ከህክምና ዘዴዎች እና ከበርካታ አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች መስተጋብሮች የሚነሱትን ሁለቱንም ፍላጎቶች በማባዛት የታካሚ የመቋቋም አቅም ተባብሷል።

English: The Cumulative Complexity Model (CCM) posits that as the burden of disease and resulting workload increase, the patient capacity to respond to it diminishes.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gw’enfuga n’enkozesa y’obujjanjabi (CCM) gugamba nti endwadde gy’ekoma okusajjuka n’emirimu gy’omujjanjabi ne gyeyongera, obusobozi bw’omulwadde obw’okufunawo enkyukakyuka bukendeera.
Yoruba: Ọna ìgbéyẹ̀wò ajẹmọ́ bí ara alahìsàn ṣe ń gbèrú (CCM) ṣàlàyé pé bí ipa àìsàn àti àbájáde iṣẹ́ ṣe ń pọ̀ si, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni ipa àwọn aláìsàn láti rí ìwòsàn ń dínkù.
Zulu: I-Cumulative Complexity Model (CCM) ibeka ukuthi njengoba umthwalo wezifo kanye nomphumela womsebenzi ukhula, amandla esiguli okusabela kuwo ayancipha.
Hausa: Model Complexity Model (CCM) yana nuna cewa yayin da nauyin cuta da sakamakon yawan aiki yake ƙaruwa, ƙarfin majiyyaci don amsawa yana raguwa.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wa Tlhakatlhakano ye e Oketšegago (CCM) o laetša gore ge morwalo wa bolwetši le morwalo wo o tšwelelago o oketšega, bokgoni bja molwetši bja go arabela bolwetši bo a fela.
Amharic: ድምር ውስብስብነት ሞዴል (CCM) እንደሚያመለክተው የበሽታው ሸክም እና የሚያስከትለው የሥራ ጫና ሲጨምር፣ የታካሚው ምላሽ እየቀነሰ ይሄዳል።

English: In middle and high-income countries, a dedicated system of care for people living with HIV/AIDS was developed in parallel to existing systems of care for NCDs, which has been successful in increasing advocacy, political will, and healthcare worker empowerment.
Luganda: Mu mawanga agaakula edda, omuyungo gw’okujjanjaba abantu abalina HIV/AIDS gwateekebwawo nga gukwatagana n’emiyungo gy’obujjanjabi egiri mu NCDs, ekisobodde okwongeza kaweefube w’okulwanyisa endwadde, okwewaayo, n’okuyimusa abajjanjabi.
Yoruba: Ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè tí ọrọ̀ ajé wọ́n dáa díẹ̀ àti àwọn tí ọrọ̀ ajé wọn dára púpọ̀, wọn ní ètò ìtọ́jú tí ó dá dúró fún àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ní HIV/AIDS ní ẹgbẹ́kẹ̀gbẹ́ pẹlú ètò ìlera tí ó ti wà nílẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀ fún NCDs, èyí tí ní àṣeyọrí nínú mímú ìmúgbèrú bá ṣíṣe àgbàwí, ilọ́wọ́sí ìṣèlú àti ìfagbára fún àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera.
Zulu: Emazweni anemali engenayo ephakathi nendawo, kwasungulwa uhlelo oluzinikele lokunakekela abantu abaphila ne-HIV/AIDS ngokuhambisana nezinhlelo ezikhona zokunakekela ama-NCDs, olube yimpumelelo ekwandiseni ukukhulumela, intando yezombusazwe, kanye nokuhlonyiswa kwezisebenzi zezempilo.
Hausa: A cikin ƙasashe masu matsakaita da masu samun kuɗin shiga sosai, an samar da tsarin sadaukar da kai ga mutanen da suke fama da cutar HIV/AIDS daidai da tsarin kula na NCDs da ake da su, wanda ya yi nasara wajen ƙara bayar da shawarwari da jajircewa na siyasa da ƙarfafa ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinageng tša letseno la magareng le tša letseno la godimo, tshepedišo ye itšego ya tlhokomelo ya bato bao ba phelago ka HIV/AIDS e hlomilwe gotee le ditshepedišo tšeo di lego gona tša tlhokomelo ya di- NCD, yeo e ilego ya atlega go oketšeng ga tlhohleletšo, go nyaka ga baetapele ba tša sepolotiki, le maatlafatša ya bašomi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: በመካከለኛና ከፍተኛ ገቢ ባላቸው አገሮች፣ ከኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ ጋር ለሚኖሩ ሰዎች ከኤንሲዲዎች የእንክብካቤ ሥርዓቶች ጋር በትይዩ ልዩ የሆነ የእንክብካቤ ሥርዓት ተዘርግቷል፣ ይህም ተሟጋችነትን፣ ፖለቲካዊ ተነሳሽነትን፣ እና የጤና አጠባበቅ ሠራተኛ ማብቃትን በማሳደግ ረገድ ስኬታማ ሆኗል።

Luganda: Okukozesa enkola enzijuvu ey’okujjanjaba endwadde zino kusobola okukendeeza ku mugugu eri abalwadde n’okutumbula omuyungo gw’ebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Tí a bá sì ni kí a túbọ lewọ́ mọ̀ ìlànà ìsàkóso àwọn àìsàn wọ̀nyí, ó le è mú àdíkù bá ipa àìsàn lórí àláìsàn, kí ó sì mú kí àtúnṣe bá ìgbésẹ̀ ètò ìlera.
Zulu: Ukuthatha indlela ephelele yokuphatha lezi zifo kunganciphisa umthwalo ezigulini futhi kuthuthukise uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo kule nqubo.
Hausa: Ɗaukar cikakkiyar hanya don sarrafa waɗannan cututtuka yana iya rage nauyin marasa lafiya da kuma inganta tsarin kiwon lafiya a cikin tsari.
Northern Sotho: Go diriša mokgwa wa kakaretšo kudu go laola malwetši a go ka fokotša morwalo go balwetši le go kaonafatša lennaeo la tlhokomelo ya maphelo ka tshepedišong yeo.
Amharic: እነዚህን በሽታዎች ለመቆጣጠር የበለጠ አካታች አቀራረብን ማድረግ በታካሚዎች ላይ ያለውን ሸክም ሊቀንስ እና በሂደቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የጤና አጠባበቅ ስርዓት ሊያሻሽል ይችላል።

English: Suffering from a combination of HIV and another serious disease, like diabetes, is a common problem, especially for people living in parts of the world where rates of these diseases are high.
Luganda: Okubeera ne HIV n’endwadde endala ey’omutawaana, gamba nga sukaali, kitera nnyo okweyoleka, naddala mu bantu ababeera mu bitundu by’ensi omuli omuwendo ogwa waggulu ogw’abantu abalina endwadde zino.
Yoruba: Kíkojú àkànpọ̀ àrùn HIV àti àrun mìíràn tí ó lágbára, bíi ìtọ̀ṣúga jẹ́ ìṣòro tí ó wọ́pọ̀,   fún àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ń gbé ní àwọn agbègbé tí àwọn àrùn wọ̀nyí tí wọ́pọ̀ ní àgbáyé.
Zulu: Ukuphathwa yinhlanganisela ye-HIV kanye nesinye isifo esiyingozi, njengesifo sikashukela, kuyinkinga evamile, ikakhulukazi kubantu abahlala ezingxenyeni zomhlaba lapho amazinga alezi zifo ephezulu.
Hausa: Shan fama da haɗuwa da cutar HIV da wata cuta mai tsanani, kamar ciwon suga, matsala ce ta gama gari, musamman ga mutanen da suke zaune a sassan duniya da adadin waɗannan cututtuka ya yi yawa.
Northern Sotho: Go ba le malwetši ka bobedi a HIV le bjo bongwe bjo kotsi, bja go swana le bolwetši bja swikiri, ke bothata bjo bo tlwaelegilego, kudukudu go batho bao ba phelago ka dikarolong tša lefase fao dipalopalo ka ga malwetši a di lego godimo kudu.
Amharic: በኤችአይቪ እና እንደ የስኳር በሽታ ያለ፣ ሌላ ከባድ በሽታ በጋራ፣ በተለይም የእነዚህ በሽታዎች ምጣኔዎች ከፍተኛ በሆነባቸው የዓለም ክፍሎች ለሚኖሩ ሰዎች፣ ስቃይ የተለመደ ችግር ነው።

English: In many cases, patients with 2 or more serious diseases must use separate parts of the healthcare system, like going to two different clinics, to receive treatment.
Luganda: Mu mbeera nnyingi, abalwadde abalina endwadde ez’omutawaana 2 oba okusingawo bateekwa okukozesa ebifo by’eddwaliro eby’enjawulo, gamba ng’okugenda mu bulwaliro bubiri obw’enjawulo, okufuna obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ kéèsì, àwọn aláìsàn tí wọn ní méjì tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ nínú àwọn àìsàn tí ó burú wọ̀nyí, wọ́n gbọdọ̀ ṣe àmúlò ẹ̀ka ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ ètò ìlera, bí ìgbà tí ènìyàn ń lọ sí ilé ìwòsàn méjì ọ̀tọ̀ọ̀tọ̀ láti gba ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Ezimweni eziningi, iziguli ezinezifo ezimbi kakhulu ezi-2 noma ngaphezulu kufanele zisebenzise izingxenye ezihlukene zohlelo lokunakekelwa kwezempilo, njengokuya emitholampilo emibili ehlukene, ukuze zithole ukwelashwa.
Hausa: A lokuta da dama, marasa lafiya masu ɗauke da manyan cututtuka 2 ko fiye dole ne su yi amfani da sassa daban-daban na tsarin kiwon lafiya, kamar zuwa asibitoci daban-daban guda biyu, don samun magani.
Northern Sotho: Mabakeng a mantši, baletši bao ba nago le malwetši a kotsi a 2 goba go feta ba swanetše go šomiša karolo ye e aroganego ya lenaneo la tlhokomelo ya maphelo, go swana le go ya dikliniking tše pedi tše di fapanego, go hwetša kalafo.
Amharic: በአብዛኞቹ ጉዳዮች፣ ከ2 ወይም ከዛ በላይ የሆኑ ከባድ በሽታዎች ያለባቸው ሰዎች፣ እንክብካን ለማግኘት፣ እንደ ሁለት የተያዩ ክሊኒኮች መሄድን አይነት፣ ሁለት የተለያዩ የጤና እንክብካቤ ስርዓቶችን መጠቀም አለባቸው።

English: This can make it difficult for healthcare services to give these patients the best care, and makes it harder for the patients themselves to manage their own health.
Luganda: Kino kisobola okufuuka ekizibu eri abajjanjabi okuwa abalwadde obujjanjabi obusinga, era ne kikifuula kizibu eri abalwadde bennyini okukuuma obulamu bwabwe.
Yoruba: Èyí le è mú kí ó ṣòro fún àwọn elétò ìlera láti ṣe ìtójú àwọn aláìsàn wọ̀nyí bí ó ti tọ́, tí ó si tún lè mú kí ó nira fún àwọn aláìsàn pàápàá láti tọ́jú ìlera ara wọ́n.
Zulu: Lokhu kungenza kube nzima ukuthi izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo zinikeze lezi ziguli ukunakekelwa okungcono kakhulu, futhi kwenza kube nzima ezigulini ukuthi zilawule impilo yazo.
Hausa: Wannan yana iya yin wahala ga ayyuka na kiwon lafiya don ba wa waɗannan marasa lafiya mafi kyawun kulawa, kuma yana sa ya zama da wahala ga marasa lafiya da kansu su kula da lafiyar tasu.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka dira gore go be boima go ditirelo tša tlhlokomelo ya maphelo go fa balwetši ba tšona tlhokomelo ye kaone, ebile se dira gore go be boima gore balwetši ka bobona go laola maphelo a bona.
Amharic: ይህ ለጤና አጠባበቅ አገልግሎቶች ለእነዚህ ታካሚዎች የተሻለውን እንክብካቤ ለመስጠት አስቸጋሪ ያደርግባቸዋል፣ እና ለራሳቸው ለታካሚዎቹም ጤናቸውን መቆጣጠር ከባድ ያደርግባቸዋል።

English: In this study, the researchers wanted to understand how people living with multiple diseases, also called comorbidities, were affected by needing to use different parts of the health system to access care.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera engeri abantu abalina endwadde ebbiri oba okusingawo, abayitibwa bannandwaddennyingi, gye baakosebwamu olw’okwetaaga okukozesa ebifo ebijjanjabirwamu eby’enjawulo okusobola okufuna obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti ní òye ipa tí ìwulò láti ṣe àmúlò onírúurú ẹ̀ka ilé ìwòsàn láti gba ìtọ́jú ń kọ ní ayé àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n ní jú àrun kan lọ, èyí tí a tún mọ̀ sí akójọpọ̀ àrun (comorbidities).
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda ukuthi abantu abaphila nezifo eziningi, ezibuye zibizwe ngokuthi yi-comorbidities, bathinteka kanjani ngenxa yokudinga ukusebenzisa izingxenye ezahlukene zohlelo lwezempilo ukuze bathole ukunakekelwa.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su fahimci yadda mutanen da suke fama da cututtuka masu yawa, wanda ake kira comorbidities, suke fama da buƙatar amfani da sassa daban-daban na tsarin kiwon lafiya domin samun kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša ka fao batho bao ba phelago ka malwetši a mantši, ao gape a bitšwago malwetši a go sepela mmogo, ba ilego ba amega ge ba nyaka go šomiša dikarolo tše di fapafapanego tša lenaneo la maphelo go fihlelela tlhokomelo.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ ከተለያዩ በሽታዎች ጋር የሚኖሩ፣ እንዲሁም ኮሞራቢዲቲስ ተብለው የሚጠሩት ሰዎች፣ የጤና ስርዓቱን የተለያዩ ክፍሎች በመጣቀም እንክብካቤ ማግኘት ስለሚያስፈልጋቸው እንዴት እንደተጎዱ ለመረዳት ፈልገዋል።

English: They also wanted to see whether it became more difficult for patients to cope with their diseases when they had to spend more time on medical visits, self-care, and treatments.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baayagala okulaba oba nga kyafuuka kizibu eri abalwadde okumanyiira endwadde zaabwe bwe baali nga balina okumala ebbanga ddene okugenda mu ddwaliro, okwejjanjaba n’okufuna obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún fẹ́ láti mọ̀ bóyá àìsàn túbọ̀ máa n nira fún àwọn aláìsàn nígbàtí wọ́n bá ní láti lo ìgbà pípẹ́ ní ilé ìwòsàn, ṣíṣe àbójútó ara ẹni àti àwọn ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Babefuna nokubona ukuthi ingabe kuba nzima ngokwengeziwe ngeziguli ukubhekana nezifo zazo lapho kudingeka zichithe isikhathi esengeziwe ekuhambeleni kwezokwelapha, ukuzinakekela, nokwelashwa.
Hausa: Sun kuma so su ga ko yana zama da wuya ga majiyyata su jure wa cututtukansu a lokacin da suke da ƙarin lokaci don ziyarar likita da kula da kanss da kuma jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba ile ba nyaka go tseba ge eba go bile boima kudu go balwetši go kgona go phela ka malwetši a bona ge ba swanetše ke go tšea nako ye ntši go diketelo tša kalafo, boitlhokomelo, le dikalafo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ሕመምተኞች በሕክምና ጉብኝት፣ ራስን በመንከባከብና በሕክምናዎች ብዙ ጊዜ በሚያሳልፉበት ጊዜ ሕመማቸውን መቋቋም የበለጠ አስቸጋሪ ሆኖባቸው እንደሆነ ለማየት ፈልገው ነበር።

English: The researchers focused on patients in South Africa and the Caribbean, two areas with high rates of HIV and other chronic diseases.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza essira baalissa ku balwadde mu ggwanga lya South Africa n’erya Caribbean, ebitundu ebibiri ebirina omuwendo omunene ogw’abantu abalina HIV n’endwadde endala ez’olukonziba.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìígbájúmọ́ àwọn aláìsàn ní South Africa àti ni Caribbean, àwọn agbègbè méjì tí HIV àti àwọn àìsàn tí ó burú jáì pọ̀ sí jùlọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bagxile ezigulini zaseNingizimu Afrika naseCaribbean, izindawo ezimbili ezinamazinga aphezulu e-HIV nezinye izifo ezingelapheki.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun mayar da hankali ne a kan marasa lafiya a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Caribbean, yankuna biyu masu yawan kamuwa da cutar HIV da sauran cututtuka masu tsanani.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiša ba ile ba nepiša balwetši ba ka Afrika Borwa le ka Caribbean, mafela a mabedi ao a nago le dipalopalo tša godimo tša HIV le malwetši a mangwe a go se fole.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በካሪቢያን አካባቢ፣ ከፍተኛ የኤችአይቪ እና ሌሎች ሥር የሰደዱ በሽታዎች ባሉባቸው አካባቢዎች፣ የሚገኙ ታካሚዎች ላይ ያተኮሩ ናቸው።

English: They asked patients with HIV and diabetes to explain how much time and energy they typically spent on treatment and managing their health.
Luganda: Baasaba abalwadde abalina HIV ne sukaali okunnyonnyola obudde n’amaanyi bye baakozesanga mu kujjanjabwa n’okukuuma obulamu bwabwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n béèrè lọ́wọ́ àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní HIV àti ìtọ̀ṣúgà láti ṣàlàyé iye ìgbà àti agbára tí wọhn máa ń lò lórí ìtọjú àti ìsàkóso ìlera wọn.
Zulu: Bacele iziguli ezine-HIV nesifo sikashukela ukuthi zichaze ukuthi singakanani isikhathi namandla ezivame ukuzisebenzisa ekwelashweni nasekulawuleni impilo yazo.
Hausa: Sun tambayi marasa lafiya da suke ɗauke da cutar HIV da ciwon suga su bayyana yawan lokaci da kuzarin da suka saba kashewa a kan jiyya da kula da lafiyarsu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgopela balwetši bao ba bego ba na le HIV le bolwetši bja swikiri go hlaloša gore ke nako ye kaakang le maatla tšeo ba di šomišago ka tlwaelo go kalafo le go laola maphelo a bona.
Amharic: በኤችአይቪ እና በስኳር በሽታ የተያዙ ታካሚዎች ለህክምና እና ጤንነታቸውን ለመቆጣጠር በተለምዶ ምን ያህል ጊዜ እና ጉልበት እንደሚያጠፉ እንዲያብራሩ ጠይቀዋል።

English: They were also interested in how well these patients were able to cope with their own healthcare requirements.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baayagala okumanya engeri abalwadde bano gye baasobolamu okumanyiira ebyetaago by’obujjanjabi bwabwe.
Yoruba: Bákan náà ni ó tún wù wọ́n láti mọ bí àwọn aláìsàn wọ̀nyí ṣe ń kọjú àwọn bùkátà tí ó rọ̀ mọ́ ètò ìlera wọn.
Zulu: Babenesithakazelo nokuthi lezi ziguli zazikwazi kanjani ukubhekana nezidingo zazo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Hausa: Haka nan ssun kuma yi sha’awar yadda waɗannan majiyyatan suka iya jure wa nasu buƙatun kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba be ba na le kgahlego mabapi le gore balwetši ba be ba kgona gabotse bjang go phela ka dinyakwa tša bona tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: እንዲሁም እነዚህ ታካሚዎች የራሳቸውን የጤና እንክብካቤ መስፈርቶች እንዴት በሚገባ መቋቋም እንደቻሉ ለማወቅ ፍላጎት ነበራቸው።

English: For example, they asked whether patients had enough financial and social support, and whether they felt like they had enough information about managing the diseases.
Luganda: Okugeza, baabuuza oba ng’abalwadde baalina obuyambi obumala mu byensimbi n’abantu mu kitundu, n’okuba oba nga baali bawulira nga balina obubaka obumala obukwata ku kujjanjaba endwadde.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, wọ́n béèrè bóyá àwọn aláìsàn ní ìrànlọ́wọ́ owó tí ó tó àti pé, bóyá wọ́n lérò pé àwọn ní ìmọ̀ tí ó pọ̀ tó lórí ìsàkóso àwọn àìsàn wọ̀nyí.
Zulu: Isibonelo, babuze ukuthi ingabe iziguli zinakho yini ukwesekwa okwanele ngokwezimali nezenhlalo, nokuthi ingabe zizizwa sengathi zinolwazi olwanele mayelana nokuphatha izifo.
Hausa: Alal misali, sun tambayi ko marasa lafiya suna da isasshen tallafin kuɗi da zamantakewa, kuma ko suna jin kamar suna da isasshen bayani game da kula da cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, ba ile ba botšiša ge eba balwetši ba bile le thekgo ye e lekaneg ya ditšhelete le ya tša leago, le gee ba ba ikwele e ke ba na le tshedimošo ye e lekanego ka ga go laola malwetši.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ ታማሚዎች በቂ የገንዘብ እና የማህበራዊ ድጋፍ አግኝተው እንደነበር፣ እና ስለበሽታዎቹ አያያዝ በቂ መረጃ እንዳላቸው ተሰምቷቸው እንደሆነ ጠይቀዋል።

English: In total, the researchers interviewed 21 patients in South Africa, and 20 in the Caribbean countries of Trinidad and Barbados.
Luganda: Awamu, abanoonyereza baabuuza abalwadde 21 mu ggwanga lya South Africa, n’abalwadde 20 mu mawanga ga Trinidad ne Barbados agasangibwa mu kitundu kya Caribbean.
Yoruba: Ní àkótán, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò fún àwọn aláìsàn 21ní South Africa àti àwọn 20 ni orílẹ̀ èdè Caribbean ti Trinidad àti Barbados.
Zulu: Sekukonke, abacwaningi baxoxisane neziguli ezingama-21 eNingizimu Afrika, nezingu-20 emazweni aseCaribbean eTrinidad naseBarbados.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, masu binciken sun yi hira da marasa lafiya guda 21 a Afirka ta Kudu, da kuma guda 20 a cikin ƙasashen Caribbean na Trinidad da kuma Barbados.
Northern Sotho: Ka moka, banyakišiši ba ile ba botsološa balwetši ba 21 ka Afrika Borwa, le ba 20 ka dinageng tša Caribbean tša Trinidad le Barbados.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ፣ ተመራማሪዎቹ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ 21፣ እና በካሪቢያን ትሪንዳድ እና ባርባዶስ አገሮች ውስጥ 20፣ ታካሚዎችን ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል።

English: They then analysed the interviews to find out the main challenges the patients were dealing with.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma beekaliriza okubuuzibwa okusobola okuzuula okusoomooza okukulu abalwadde kwe baali bayitamu.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náà ni wọ́n ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò láti mọ àwọn ìṣòro tí ó ṣe pàtàkì jùlọ tí àwọn aláìsàn ń kọjú.
Zulu: Babe sebehlaziya inhlolokhono ukuthola izinselelo ezinkulu iziguli ezibhekene nazo.
Hausa: Daga nan sai suka yi nazarin hirarrakin don gano manyan ƙalubalolin da majinyatan suke fama da su.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba sekaseka dipoledišano tšeo go tseba ditlhohlo tše kgolo tšeo balwetši ba bego ba lebane le tšona.
Amharic: ከዚያም ታካሚዎቹ ያጋጠሟቸውን ዋና ዋና ተግዳሮቶች ለማወቅ ቃለ-መጠይቆቹን ተንትነዋል።

English: In general, the study showed that patients with both HIV and diabetes were not receiving adequate healthcare services.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, okunoonyereza kwalaga nti abalwadde abalina HIV ne sukaali baali tebafuna bulungi bujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Ní gbogboògbò, iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí ṣe àfihàn pé àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní HIV àti ìtọ̀ṣúgà kò rí iléra tí ó tọ́ gbà.
Zulu: Ngokuvamile, ucwaningo lwabonisa ukuthi iziguli ezinakho kokubili i-HIV nesifo sikashukela zazingatholi izinsizakalo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ezanele.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, binciken ya nuna cewa marasa lafiya da suke ɗauke da cutar HIV da ciwon suga ba sa samun isassun ayyuka na kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, dinyakišišo di ile tša bontšha gore balwetši bao ba bego ba na le bobedi HIV le bolwetši bja swikiri ba be ba sa amogele ditirelo tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ፣ ጥናቱ እንደሚያሳየው ሁለቱም ኤችአይቪ እና የስኳር ህመም ያለባቸው ታካሚዎች በቂ የጤና አገልግሎቶች እያገኙ አይደለም።

English: In both parts of the world, the researchers found that patients spent a lot of time waiting in clinics.
Luganda: Mu bitundu by’ensi byombi, abanoonyereza baazuula ng’abalwadde baamala ebbanga ddene nga balinda mu bulwaliro.
Yoruba: Ní àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè méjèèjì, àwọn olùwádìí ri pé àwọn aláìsàn máa ń lo ìgbà tí ó pọ̀ púpọ̀ láti dúró ní ilé ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Kuzo zombili izingxenye zomhlaba, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi iziguli zichitha isikhathi esiningi zilindile emitholampilo.
Hausa: A duka sassan biyu na duniya, masu binciken sun gano cewa marasa lafiya sunna ɓata lokaci mai yawa suna jira a asibitoci.
Northern Sotho: Ka go dikarolo tše tša lefase ka bobedi, banyakišiši ba utollotše gore balwetši ba tšea nako ye ntši a letetše ka dikliniking.
Amharic: በሁለቱም የዓለም ክፍሎች፣ ታካሚዎች በክሊኒኮች ውስጥ በመጠበቅ ብዙ ጊዜን እንደሚያጠፉ ተመራማሪዎቹ አውቀዋል።

English: Both groups also mentioned spending a lot of time taking medicine and eating correctly to manage their diabetes.
Luganda: Ebibinja byombi era byakoona ku ky’okumala ebbanga eddene nga bali ku ddagala n’okulya mu ngeri entuufu okusobola okujjanjaba sukaali waabwe.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀ka méjèèjì ńà tún mẹ́nubà pé ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ìgbà ni àwọn máa ń lò láti lo oògun, kí wọ́n sì jẹun bí ó ti tọ láti ójútó ìtọ̀ṣúgà.
Zulu: Womabili la maqembu aphinde athi ukuchitha isikhathi esiningi ephuza umuthi nokudla ngendlela efanele ukuze alawule isifo sikashukela.
Hausa: Dka ƙungiyoyin biyu sun kuma ambaci ɓata lokaci mai yawa wajen shan magani da cin abinci daidai don sarrafa ciwon suga.
Northern Sotho: Dihlpha tše ka bobedi le tšona di boletše gore di tšea nako ye ntši ba enwa dihlare le go ja ka maleba go laola bolwetši bja bona bja swikiri.
Amharic: ሁለቱም ቡድኖች በተጨማሪ መድኃኒታቸውን በመውሰድ እና የስኳር በሽታቸውን ለመቆጣጠር በትክክል መመገብ ላይ ብዙ ጊዜ እንደሚያጠፉ አውሰተዋል።

English: In South Africa, patients reported a shortage of healthcare professionals and medicine as challenges they faced when getting treatment.
Luganda: Mu ggwanga lya South Africa, abalwadde baasonga ku bbula ly’abasawo abakugu n’eddagala ng’okusoomooza kwe baafunanga nga bafuna obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Ní South Africa, àwọn aláìsàn fi léde pé lára àwọn ìṣòro tí àwọn máa ń kọjú ní láti gba itọjú ní àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ètò ìlera àti oògùn kò pọ̀ tó.
Zulu: ENingizimu Afrika, iziguli zibike ukushoda kochwepheshe bezempilo kanye nemithi njengezinselelo ezibhekana nazo lapho zelashwa.
Hausa: A Afirka ta Kudu, marasa lafiya sun bayar da rahoton ƙarancin ƙwararru kan kiwon lafiya da magunguna a matsayin ƙalubalolin da suke fuskanta a lokacin samun magani.
Northern Sotho: In South Africa, patients reported a shortage of healthcare professionals and medicine as challenges they faced when getting treatment.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ታካሚዎች ህክምና በሚያገኙበት ጊዜ የጤና እንክብካቤ ባለሙያዎችን እና መድኃኒት እጥረትን እንደ ተግዳሮቶች ሪፖርት አድርገዋል።

English: They also faced social stigma, especially about having HIV.
Luganda: Baayitanga ne mu kuboolebwa abantu mu kitundu, naddala ku ky’okuba ne HIV.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún mẹ́nubá ìddojúkọ ìdẹ́yẹsí ní àwùjọ, pàahpàá nípa níní kòkòrò HIV.
Zulu: Baphinde babhekana nokucwaswa emphakathini, ikakhulukazi ngokuba ne-HIV.
Hausa: Sun kuma fuskanci ƙyama a cikin al’umma, musamman game da kamuwa da cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Gape ba ile ba lebana le kgobošo ka setšhaba, kudukudu ka ga HIV.
Amharic: በተለይም ኤችአይቪ ስላለባቸው፣ ማህበራዊ መገለልም ገጥሟቸዋል።

English: Many patients added that having financial and family support, enough information about the diseases and a positive attitude helped them overcome some of their problems.
Luganda: Abalwadde bangi baayongerako ne bagamba nti okufuna obuyambi bw’ensimbi n’obuwangizi bwa famire zaabwe, okubeera n’obubaka obukwata ku ndwadde obumala n’okubeera n’okukkiriza nti bajja kutereera byabayambako okuvvuunuka ebizibu byabwe ebimu.
Yoruba: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn aláìsàn fi kún un pé níní ìrànlọ́wọ́ owó àti ti ẹbí, ìmọ̀ tí ó kún lórí àwọn àìsàn wọn àti ì̀wà tí ó tọ̀na ni ó ń r̀n wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti borí díẹ̀ nínú àwọn ìṣòro wọn.
Zulu: Iziguli eziningi zanezela ukuthi ukusekelwa ngokwezimali nomkhaya, ukwaziswa okwanele ngezifo nesimo sengqondo esiqondile kuzisize zanqoba ezinye zezinkinga zazo.
Hausa: Yawancin marasa lafiya sun ƙara da cewa samun tallafin kuɗi da iyali da isassun bayanai game da cututtuka da kuma halin kirki suna taimaka musu su shawo kan wasu matsalolinsu.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba bantši ba tlaleleditše ka gore go ba le thekgo ya ditšhelete le ya ka malapeng, Tshedimošo ye e lekanego ka ga bolwetši bjo le maikutlo a makaone go ile gwa ba thuša go fenya a mangwe a mathata.
Amharic: ብዙ ሕመምተኞች የገንዘብና የቤተሰብ ድጋፍ ማግኘታቸው፣ እና ስለበሽታዎቹ በቂ መረጃና አዎንታዊ አመለካከትን ማግኘታቸው አንዳንድ ችግሮቻቸውን እንዲያሸንፉ እንደረዳቸውም አክለዋል።

English: In the Caribbean, patients reported losing income due to having to wait at clinics and expressed concerns about confidentiality when going for HIV treatment.
Luganda: Mu kitundu kya Caribbean, abalwadde baagamba nti baafiirwa okuyingiza ensimbi olw’okwetaaga okulinda mu bulwaliro era ne balaga okweraliikirira kwabwe eri okukuuma ebibakwatako nga bya kyama nga bagenda okufuna obujjanjabi bwa HIV.
Yoruba: Ní Caribbean, àwọn aláìsàn fi léde pé àwọn máa ń pàdánú owó látàrí pípẹ́ tí awọn ń pẹ́ ní ilé ìwòsàn, wọn tún fi ẹ̀dùn ọkan wọn han nípa ìbòláṣìírí ní ìgbà tí àwọn bá ń lọ láti gba ìtọ́jú HIV.
Zulu: E-Caribbean, iziguli zabika ukuthi zilahlekelwe yimali engenayo ngenxa yokulinda emitholampilo futhi zazwakalisa ukukhathazeka mayelana nokugcinwa kuyimfihlo lapho ziya kokwelashwa kwe-HIV.
Hausa: A cikin Caribbean, marasa lafiya sun ba da rahoton asarar samun kuɗin shiga saboda jira a asibitoci kuma sun bayyana damuwa game da sirri lokacin da za su je maganin cutar HIV.
Northern Sotho: Ka dinageng tša ka Caribbean, balwetši ba begile gore ba lahlegelwa ke letseno ka ge ba swanetše go leta ka dikliniking ebile ba laetša dipelaelo ka ga sephiri ge ba eya go hwetša dihlare tša HIV.
Amharic: በካሪቢያን አካባቢ፣ ታካሚዎች ክሊኒኮች ውስጥ በመጠባበቅ ምክንያት ገቢያቸውን እንዳጡ እና ለኤችአይቪ ህክምና በሚሄዱበት ጊዜ ምስጢራዊነት እንደሚያሳስባቸው ገልጸዋል።

English: Like patients in South Africa, Caribbean patients also faced stigma and discrimination to do with their HIV diagnosis, which added to the emotional and mental challenges of living with the disease.
Luganda: Nga bwe kiri ku balwadde b’omu South Africa, abalwadde b’omu kitundu kya Caribbean nabo baayita mu kwennyamira n’okuboolebwa abantu mu kitundu mu kukeberebwa obulwadde bwa HIV, ne kyongera ku kusoomooza omuntu kw’aba nakwo ng’alina endwadde eyo.
Yoruba: Bí àwọn aláìsàn ní South Africa, àwọn aláìsàn Caribbean náà máa ń kọjú ìdẹ́yẹsí àti ìyàsọ́tọ̀ ní àwùjọ nípa pé wọ́n ní HIV, èyí tí ó dákún ìṣòro ìmọ̀sílára àti ti ọpọlọ nípa gbigbé pẹ̀ú àìsàn náà.
Zulu: Njengeziguli zaseNingizimu Afrika, iziguli zaseCaribbean nazo zabhekana nokucwaswa nokucwaswa okuhlobene nokuxilongwa kwazo kwe-HIV, okwanezela ezinseleleni ezingokomzwelo nezingokwengqondo zokuphila nalesi sifo.
Hausa: Kamar marasa lafiya a Afirka ta Kudu, majiyyatan Caribbean suma suna fuskantar ƙyama da nuna wariya dangane da gano cutar HIV, wanda ya daɗa ƙalubalolin zuciya da tunani na rayuwa tare da cutar.
Northern Sotho: Go swana le balwetši ba ka Afrika Borwa, balwetši ba ka Caribbean le bona ba ile ba lebana le bogoboga le kgtehloganyo bja go itirela phekolo ya bona ya HIV, yeo e okeditšego ditlhohlo tša maikutlo le tša monagano tša go phela ka bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: እንደ ደቡብ አፍሪካ ታማሚዎች ሁሉ፣ የካሪቢያን ታማሚዎችም ስሜታዊ እና አእምሯዊ ተግዳሮቶችን ከበሽታው ጋር የመኖር በጨመረው የኤችአይቪ ምርመራቸው፣ ላይ መገለልና መድልዎ ገጥሟቸዋል።

English: The researchers said that these findings show that there is a need for healthcare systems to focus more on patients, rather than specific diseases, and to take a more holistic approach to care.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bino ebyazuulibwa biraga nti waliwo obwetaavu bw’emiyungo gy’ebyobulamu okussa ennyo essira ku balwadde, okusinga endwadde ez’ekika ekimu, n’okukozesa enkola ey’enzijanjaba enzijuvu mu kujjanjaba abalwadde.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé àwọn àbájáde ìwádìí wọ̀nyí fi hàn pé ìwulò wà fún ètò ìlera láti túbọ̀ gbájúmọ́ àwọn aláìsàn jú àìsàn lọ, kí wọ́n sì túbọ lewọ́ mọ̀ ìlànà ìsàkóso ìtọ́jú.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe lokhu okutholakele kukhombisa ukuthi kunesidingo sokuthi izinhlelo zokunakekelwa kwempilo zigxile kakhulu ezigulini, hhayi ezifweni ezithile, futhi kuthathwe indlela ebanzi yokunakekela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce, waɗannan sakamakon binciken sun nuna cewa akwai buƙatar tsarin kiwon lafiya da ya fi mayar da hankali a kan marasa lafiya, maimakon takamaiman cututtuka, da kuma ɗaukar cikakken tsarin kulawa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dikutollo tše di laetša go na le tlhokego ya  mananeo a tlhokomelo ya maphelo go nepiša balwetši ba bantši, sebakeng sa malwetši a itšego, le go diriša mokgwa wa kakaretšo kudu wa tlhokomelo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እነዚህ ግኝቶች የጤና አጠባበቅ ሥርዓቶች ከተለዩ በሽታዎች ይልቅ፣ ለታካሚዎች የበለጠ ትኩረት እንዲሰጡ እና ተጨማሪ አካታች አቀራረብን እንዲያደርጉ እንደሚያስፈልግ ያሳያሉ ብለዋል።

English: For example, patients in the Caribbean wanted HIV facilities to also help with their other healthcare needs as well.
Luganda: Okugeza, abalwadde mu kitundu kya Caribbean baali baagala amalwaliro agajjanjaba HIV gabe nga gakola ne ku bujjanjabi obulala bwe beetaaga.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn aláìsàn ní Caribbean fẹ́ kí ilé ìwòsàn fún HIV náà le è bójútó gbogbo ìlera wọn lápapọ̀.
Zulu: Isibonelo, iziguli zaseCaribbean zazifuna izikhungo ze-HIV zisize nangezinye izidingo zazo zokunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Hausa: Alal misali, marasa lafiya a cikin Caribbean suna son wuraren HIV su ma su taimaka da sauran buƙatunsu na kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, balwetši ba ka Caribbean ba be ba nyaka gore mafelo a go alafela HIV gore le ona a thuše ka dinyakwa tša bona tše dingwe tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ በካሪቢያን የሚገኙ ታካሚዎች የኤችአይቪ ተቋሞች በሌሎች የጤና እንክብካቤ ፍላጎቶቻቸው ላይም እንዲረዷቸው ይፈልጋሉ።

English: The researchers added that healthcare systems should therefore be redesigned and expanded to improve treatment for people with comorbidities.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayongerako ne bagamba nti emiyungo gy’ebyobulamu noolwekyo gisaanye giddemu okutegekebwa n’okugaziyizibwa okusobola okutumbula obujjanjabi bw’abantu abalina endwadde ebbiri oba okusingawo.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí fi kún un pé fún ìdí èyí àtúngbékalẹ̀ gbọdọ̀ wà fún èto ìlera kí wọhn sì fẹ̀ ẹ́ lójú láti mú àtúnṣe bá ìtọ́jú àwọn èníyàn tí wọ́n ní oní rúurú àìsàn.
